adhd.modalSubtitle: Overcome activation paralysis by crushing tasks into low-friction 5-min micro-steps
adhd.magicRuleDesc: Tell yourself: 'I will only do this for 5 minutes. When timer rings, I am 100% free to stop!' Usually, starting is 90% of the friction.
adhd.presetTitle: 🤖 Smart Micro-Step Suggestions (Click to edit or add):
adhd.step1DescDesign: Open CAD / Design software, locate and open target project file
adhd.step2DescDesign: Just zoom in on yesterday's grid or title block, no rush to draw
adhd.step3DescDesign: Roughly place 1 reference line or pick 1 template block
adhd.step1DescDoc: Open document/sheet, take a sip of water and breathe
adhd.step2DescDoc: Glance through table headers or the first 3 items
adhd.step3DescDoc: Quickly fill in the first known number or rough paragraph
adhd.step1DescGeneral: Put on headphones, sip water, open target folder or workspace
adhd.step2DescGeneral: Just glance at the last line, or draft a 1-sentence title
adhd.step3DescGeneral: Don't aim for perfection; jot down 3 quick bullet points
adhd.addAsSubtasks: Add these 3 micro-steps as daily tasks
adhd.timerSubHint: Only commit 5 minutes. You are 100% free to stop after, zero guilt.
adhd.timerDoneTitle: 🎉 Amazing! You crushed the hardest part: STARTING!
adhd.timerDoneSubtitle: Your executive barrier is down. Would you like to keep riding this momentum, or take a guilt-free rest?
adhd.markDoneRest: ✅ Mark Started / Done, take a rest

landing.heroSubtitle: A lightweight project acceleration tool for indie creators and micro-teams. Turn chaotic milestones into structured daily tasks with backward scheduling.
landing.sampleTask1: Kickoff: Organize floor plan & material specs
landing.whySubtitle: Focus on actual execution, eliminate endless planning meetings, and defeat procrastination with certainty.
landing.feature1Desc: No need to manually schedule each day. Provide the deadline, and our weighted algorithm splits milestones into actionable daily steps.
landing.feature2Desc: Keep your workspace clean. Archive finished milestones to preserve your history while releasing active project capacity.
landing.feature3Desc: Everything you need at a glance: navigation on the left, daily checklist in the center, and live progress overview on the right.
landing.footerSlogan: Orderly Workbench - Smart Backward Scheduling & Task Management

reminders.modalSubtitle: Set calm cadence for goals with calendar sync, email & bot pushes
reminders.gentleDesc: No anxiety, no aggressive pushes. The system only invites you to reflect on key milestones, and allows you to dismiss or adjust cadence anytime.
reminders.shortTermDesc: For upcoming project deadlines, maintain steady pace with gentle daily micro check-ins.
reminders.longTermDesc: Big multi-month goals don't need daily nagging. A gentle weekly reflection keeps the ship on course.
reminders.browserNotificationDesc: Send gentle task agenda reminders when workbench is running in background
reminders.dismissHint: Will not bother you today; resumes tomorrow
reminders.calDesc: Generates universal iCalendar (.ics) format. Once imported, iPhone / Android native Calendar apps automatically push lock-screen alarms on schedule without opening the web app!
reminders.calActionSub: Packages all today's tasks and project deadlines into standard calendar events
reminders.emailSectionDesc: Automatically sends your scheduled today's checklist and upcoming deadlines to your inbox every morning at 09:00.
reminders.botsIntro: Push daily agendas and project updates directly into your everyday chat apps and group channels:
